set.body: Parent ScalaFIM eco-u5-core. Surface metadata, fields, topology adapters, reference admission, GIFTI/FreeSurfer codecs and owned fixtures must run independently. Keep mesh/domain/frame provider authority and exact persisted identities. Registration and volume sampling are optional modules. Acceptance: boundary detector plus full core JVM/JS and IO JVM tests, independent review, then Root cutover and consumer witnesses.
set.title: Extract intrinsic surface semantics and IO without volume dependencies
